# Copilot Instructions

- Purpose: LangGraph agent workflow that researches trending tech/work topics, drafts 3 posts, picks one, evaluates, creates an image, reviews it (up to 2 retries), then posts via Metricool or saves locally.
- Entry/run: `python main.py` from repo root. Tests: `python tests/test_saver.py` and `python tests/verify_saver.py` (use real/placeholder image URLs). Output lives in `social_media_posts/` with images in `social_media_posts/images/`.
- Core flow (see `src/workflow.py`): researcher → content_creator → content_reviewer → evaluate_content (non-blocking evaluators) → prompt_engineer → image_generator → image_reviewer → poster → saver. Conditional edge from image_reviewer: if approved or retries ≥2 → poster/saver (posting depends on `ENABLE_POSTING`).
- State contract (`src/state.py`): keys include topic, research_results, draft_posts, selected_post, image_prompt/url, image_approved, critique, post_status, retry_count, day_of_week, theme, evaluation_results, node_latencies, total_latency, post_char_count, image_generation_attempts, workflow_start_time, errors. Keep mutations additive; return dict patches from nodes.
- Config (`src/config.py`): requires `OPENAI_API_KEY` or `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` (else raises). Optional `TAVILY_API_KEY` or `BRAVE_API_KEY` for research. `ENABLE_POSTING` flag routes to poster; Metricool needs `METRICOOL_API`, `METRICOOL_USER_ID`, `METRICOOL_BLOG_ID`. LangSmith tracing via `LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2=true` + `LANGCHAIN_API_KEY`. SQLite cache at `.langchain_cache.db` is enabled by default.
- Researcher (`src/agents/researcher.py`): themed by weekday map; queries Tavily (preferred) or Brave; on missing keys/failed search, falls back to static topics. LLM (`gpt-5-mini`) picks a single topic and returns research context.
- Content creation (`src/agents/content_creator.py`): uses `gpt-5` to draft 3 posts under 280 chars, 1-2 emojis, max 1 hashtag. Parsing looks for lines starting with `1.`/`2.`/`3.`; if parsing fails, returns full content as single draft.
- Review and selection (`src/agents/content_reviewer.py`): `gpt-5-mini` selects best draft; returns plain text (no prefix). Keep selected_post concise—evaluators check length and relevance.
- Image path (`src/agents/prompt_engineer.py`, `image_generator.py`, `image_reviewer.py`): prompt_engineer increments `retry_count` and optionally uses `critique` when retrying. image_generator uses OpenAI/OpenRouter Images API (`gpt-image-1-mini` or `openai/gpt-image-1-mini`), logs full response, returns URL or data URI. image_reviewer uses vision model (`gpt-5`) and approves if response contains YES.
- Posting vs saving (`src/agents/poster.py`, `saver.py`): poster mocks if Metricool creds missing; when real, posts immediately via `POST /v2/scheduler/posts` with data-URL media upload. saver downloads images or decodes data URIs, writes markdown with relative image path; filename uses timestamp + sanitized topic (50-char cap).
- Evaluators/metrics (`src/evaluators/feedback.py`, `src/utils/metrics.py`): online evaluators (groundedness, relevance, conciseness) run in a thread pool; always pass state through and submit LangSmith feedback plus composite score and image metrics. Latency tracking wraps every node (`wrap_node_with_latency`); `node_latencies` and `total_latency` populated in `main.py`. `image_generation_attempts` increments in the wrapper for image_generator.
- Development patterns: nodes should return dict deltas; avoid mutating input state in place. Keep prompts short and deterministic where needed (temperature 0 for eval/vision). Respect retry cap (≥2 goes to poster/saver). When adding nodes, wrap with `wrap_node_with_latency(name)` for observability.
- Gotchas: Without OpenAI/OpenRouter key, app raises at import (config). Missing search keys triggers fallback topics but flow continues. If no image generated, image_reviewer returns `image_approved=False` and flow will retry until cap. Posting requires Metricool user/blog IDs; otherwise poster mocks but saver still runs.
- Observability: set LangSmith env vars to see feedback (composite_quality, groundedness, relevance, conciseness, image metrics). `run_config` in `main.py` tags runs with environment/version; keep that metadata updated when changing workflow semantics.
- Style guardrails: social posts should stay <280 chars, casual/fun tech voice, minimal hashtags, 1-2 emojis. Images: modern/minimal/tech, no text in image.
- When extending: update `AgentState` and adjust edges/conditionals in `src/workflow.py`. Keep output paths stable for tests. Add evaluator weights in `calculate_composite_score` if you change scoring priorities.
